About

Robotics-focused second-year electrical and electronics engineering student at the Federal University of Technology Akure. I build Arduino-based sensing and control systems, and I’m researching solar forecasting for renewable energy. Membership Lead of my IEEE student branch, I’m passionate about using technology to elevate Nigeria and advance sustainability and green energy.

Projects

Sound-level alarm

Arduino Uno · sound sensor · buzzer · I2C LCD

When the sound level passes a limit, the buzzer sounds, an LED turns on and the LCD shows “SOUND DETECTED! CHECK!”.

Pot-controlled servo joint

Arduino Uno · servo · LED

A potentiometer sets the servo angle, and an LED warns when the joint passes about 123°. Tested on the bench on 12 November 2026. It is the first joint of a robotic arm I want to build to help people with disabilities.

LED light sequences

Arduino Uno · LEDs on pins 11, 12 and 13

My first builds: LEDs that blink in turn, driven by digitalWrite and delay.

Ultrasonic proximity LED

Arduino Uno · ultrasonic sensor · I2C LCD · LED

The sensor measures the distance to an obstacle and shows it on the LCD. When an object comes within 20 cm the LED turns on, and when it moves away the LED turns off.
